lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in approximately vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Inter-blob distance is irregular, with higher spatial frequency in the anterior region transitioning to lower frequency and larger diameters posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the circular blobs to form a loose grid-like topological structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible running from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle, exhibiting a high-contrast vertical gradient with specular highlight on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs observed on the first dorsal fin, with higher concentration on the anterior third of the fin surface compared to the trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The left pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of small-diameter, high-luminance spots concentrated along the leading edge and distal tip.
